g.text: THE TRAP: the same job can run TWICE

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A queue guarantees 'at least once'. It does NOT guarantee 'exactly once'.

g.text: The fix: make every job IDEMPOTENT

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: IDEMPOTENT = safe to run twice. Running it again changes nothing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: How: give each job an id. Before doing it, check 'did I already do job 8891?'

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: If yes, skip it. If no, do it and write down that 8891 is finished.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Now Worker B looks, sees 8891 is already done, and quietly does nothing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: RETRY = the queue hands a failed job out again, usually a few times

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: DEAD LETTER QUEUE = a bin for jobs that failed every retry, so a human can look

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: AT-LEAST-ONCE = the promise that a job runs at least one time, maybe more

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: IDEMPOTENT = running the job twice gives the same result as running it once
